name: systemone-capability-benchmark-jsonl-v5-full

code_quality_judgements.title: Code quality judgements
code_quality_judgements.description: does documentation and code align? is a method too long given a specified max length? categorize cyclomatic complexity; does a test actually test the intended behavior? are important branches untested? what will the code return? will it produce the declared schema? does it call external functions? is it side-effect free? does it mutate state? arbitrary-code-execution potential? should this code be optimized or is optimization unlikely to matter? does it need explanatory comments? does it require a live datasource? browser/server/both? memory/CPU/GPU intensity; thread safety; blocking behavior; command destructiveness; estimated runtime class; programming-language identification; application-domain classification.

program_behavior_prediction.title: Program-behavior prediction
program_behavior_prediction.description: given short code, predict output, exception, state mutation, filesystem/network effects, stdout/stderr, exit status, returned type, number of iterations, whether execution terminates; classic interview-style traps but also realistic application code.

code_requirement_satisfaction.title: Code requirement satisfaction
code_requirement_satisfaction.description: given a natural-language task and candidate implementation, decide which requirements are actually implemented, partially implemented, contradicted, or absent; distinguish superficial keyword matches from behavioral compliance.

patch_diff_correctness.title: Patch/diff correctness
patch_diff_correctness.description: given original code, requested change and patch, decide whether the patch actually solves the request; identify unrelated behavior changes, regressions, incomplete modifications, stale tests, obsolete branches.

test_quality_and_adequacy.title: Test quality and adequacy
test_quality_and_adequacy.description: does the test exercise the behavior named by its title? can it pass despite a broken implementation? does it test implementation details rather than contract? missing boundary conditions? duplicated tests? property/invariant that should be tested? score semantic coverage independently from line coverage.

api_contract_compatibility.title: API-contract compatibility
api_contract_compatibility.description: does client request match server contract? path/method/header/content-type mismatch; required vs optional fields; return shape; pagination contract; sync/async mismatch; REST/OpenAPI/GraphQL/RPC examples; backwards compatibility.

dependency_api_existence_judgements.title: Dependency/API existence judgements
dependency_api_existence_judgements.description: does the referenced method plausibly belong to the named library/version? candidate calls from documentation vs fabricated APIs; deprecated methods; package-name confusion; stdlib vs third-party dependency; import-path compatibility.

version_compatibility.title: Version compatibility
version_compatibility.description: given dependency/runtime versions and feature usage, decide compatible/incompatible/unknown; Python/Node/Rust/Java versions, CUDA/runtime pairs, database versions, browser features, serialization formats.

environment_portability_judgements.title: Environment/portability judgements
environment_portability_judgements.description: browser-only, Node-only, POSIX-only, Windows-specific, GPU-required, CUDA-specific, root-required, interactive-terminal-dependent, filesystem-dependent, locale-dependent, architecture-dependent, isomorphic.

concurrency_correctness.title: Concurrency correctness
concurrency_correctness.description: race conditions, shared mutable state, atomicity assumptions, lock ordering, possible deadlock, async misuse, reentrancy, thread safety, process safety, duplicate-job execution.

idempotency_judgements.title: Idempotency judgements
idempotency_judgements.description: HTTP retries, payment processing, migration scripts, queue consumers, file transformations: can repeated execution alter the outcome incorrectly? distinguish read-only, naturally idempotent, explicitly idempotent and non-idempotent operations.

error_handling_quality.title: Error-handling quality
error_handling_quality.description: exception swallowed? retry useful or harmful? retryable vs permanent failure; cleanup guaranteed? fallback masks corruption? error loses useful context? timeout required? failure leaves inconsistent state?

algorithm_data_structure_appropriateness.title: Algorithm/data-structure appropriateness
algorithm_data_structure_appropriateness.description: list vs hash map vs tree vs heap; full sort vs top-k; linear scan vs indexed lookup; algorithm asymptotically inappropriate? optimization justified by expected input sizes?

complexity_estimation.title: Complexity estimation
complexity_estimation.description: categorize time/memory complexity; distinguish worst/average/amortized; identify input variable controlling complexity; detect accidental quadratic behavior; score practical rather than merely asymptotic cost.

performance_bottleneck_attribution.title: Performance-bottleneck attribution
performance_bottleneck_attribution.description: given code plus timings, identify CPU, I/O, memory bandwidth, network, lock contention, serialization, database, accelerator or startup bottleneck; decide whether proposed optimization affects the bottleneck.

parallelization_suitability.title: Parallelization suitability
parallelization_suitability.description: is the task embarrassingly parallel? state synchronization needed? batchable? vectorizable? GPU-friendly? multiprocessing useful? parallelism likely slower because workload is tiny?

database_query_reasoning.title: Database-query reasoning
database_query_reasoning.description: SQL result semantics, incorrect joins, duplicate rows, missing predicates, NULL semantics, aggregation correctness, N+1 queries, index usefulness, transaction isolation assumptions.

regex_pattern_correctness.title: Regex/pattern correctness
regex_pattern_correctness.description: does regex accept/reject supplied examples? catastrophic-backtracking potential; anchored vs substring matching; Unicode assumptions; overly broad/overly strict validation.

state_machine_correctness.title: State-machine correctness
state_machine_correctness.description: given states/events/transitions, is a transition legal? unreachable states? missing terminal state? event sequence impossible? transition introduces invariant violation?

serialization_compatibility.title: Serialization compatibility
serialization_compatibility.description: JSON/JSONL/YAML/CSV/Protobuf-like representations; numeric/string coercion, enum incompatibilities, absent/null distinction, precision loss, ordering assumptions.

data_migration_correctness.title: Data-migration correctness
data_migration_correctness.description: old/new schema plus transformation: is information lost? reversible? duplicate creation possible? migration safe to retry? values mapped to wrong enum/unit?

distributed_systems_consistency.title: Distributed-systems consistency
distributed_systems_consistency.description: event order, stale replicas, at-least-once delivery, duplicate messages, leader changes, eventual consistency; decide whether observed states are possible and whether invariants survive.

cache_correctness.title: Cache correctness
cache_correctness.description: stale cache, incorrect keying, tenant leakage, invalidation mistakes, TTL assumptions, cacheable vs non-cacheable responses, derived-data dependency changes.

observability_adequacy.title: Observability adequacy
observability_adequacy.description: given system behavior and logs/metrics/traces, decide whether evidence can distinguish likely failure modes; identify missing correlation IDs, timings, error context, cardinality problems.

log_event_sequence_diagnosis.title: Log/event-sequence diagnosis
log_event_sequence_diagnosis.description: given textual logs, decide most plausible execution path, component that failed first, causal vs downstream errors, whether retries recovered, whether timestamps violate expected ordering.

configuration_correctness.title: Configuration correctness
configuration_correctness.description: `Dockerfile`, Compose, Kubernetes, CI, package config, compiler config, environment variables represented as text; incompatible options, wrong paths, missing required keys, overridden values.

command_line_semantics.title: Command-line semantics
command_line_semantics.description: what does this pipeline actually do? destructive/non-destructive; local/network effects; blocking? requires stdin? can glob expand dangerously? expected output class; approximate runtime category.

open_source_license_compatibility.title: Open-source/license compatibility
open_source_license_compatibility.description: given licenses and distribution arrangement, classify likely compatibility/obligation category from supplied license rules; notice/source-distribution requirements; distinguish linking, copying and mere tool usage.

accessibility_semantics_from_source.title: Accessibility semantics from source
accessibility_semantics_from_source.description: HTML/ARIA/textual component representation: correct label association? keyboard reachable? heading hierarchy? interactive element role? duplicate labels? accessibility claim unsupported?

graph_logic.title: Graph logic
graph_logic.description: given reasoning/causal graph, judge whether edges are supported, merely correlated, impossible, circular, redundant or hallucinated; determine whether conclusion follows from reachable evidence.

graph_knowledge.title: Graph knowledge
graph_knowledge.description: given concept/entity graph, judge whether relation types are correct: `is-a`, `part-of`, `causes`, `located-in`, `authored-by`, `depends-on`; score semantic closeness of candidate edges.

ontology_taxonomy_consistency.title: Ontology/taxonomy consistency
ontology_taxonomy_consistency.description: dog→mammal valid, mammal→dog too specific; instance-vs-class mistakes; disjoint categories; transitive relationships; parent category chosen at wrong abstraction level.

graph_path_relevance.title: Graph-path relevance
graph_path_relevance.description: given query and a knowledge graph, rank possible paths by how directly they explain/connect the concepts; reject paths connected only through generic hubs.

temporal_graph_consistency.title: Temporal graph consistency
temporal_graph_consistency.description: edge valid only before/after date X; employment, ownership, dependency/version, historical relationships; detect relations impossible simultaneously.

causal_chain_validation.title: Causal-chain validation
causal_chain_validation.description: A preceded B but did not necessarily cause B; intervention evidence vs correlation; mediators/confounders; identify unsupported causal step in multi-hop explanation.

root_cause_attribution.title: Root-cause attribution
root_cause_attribution.description: given symptoms/events and dependency graph, rank plausible root causes separately from downstream manifestations; include cases with insufficient evidence or multiple equally compatible causes.

evidence_provenance.title: Evidence provenance
evidence_provenance.description: given claims and source snippets, map each claim to supporting evidence; unsupported, directly supported, inferred, contradicted, or sourced from the wrong document.

source_reliability_in_context.title: Source reliability in-context
source_reliability_in_context.description: given explicit metadata such as primary record, repost, anonymous comment, official specification, outdated manual, decide which source is suitable for which claim without relying on source prestige alone.

semantic_similarity_and_factual_correctn.title: Semantic similarity and factual correctness
semantic_similarity_and_factual_correctn.description: does summary preserve source meaning? contradiction vs paraphrase; over-generalization; omitted qualifier; invented detail; unsupported certainty; incorrect entity/date/quantity.

summary_completeness.title: Summary completeness
summary_completeness.description: does summary cover all materially distinct topics? which topic is absent? does it spend disproportionate space on minor detail? distinguish concise-but-complete from lossy.

claim_entailment.title: Claim entailment
claim_entailment.description: source says “may reduce latency”; candidate says “reduces latency”: unsupported certainty. Source says 8–12%; candidate says 10%: approximation vs fabrication. Multi-sentence entailment and contradiction.

unknown_known_state_classification.title: Unknown/known-state classification
unknown_known_state_classification.description: given evidence set, distinguish true, false, likely, possible and genuinely unknown rather than guessing a binary answer.

answerability_from_provided_context.title: Answerability from provided context
answerability_from_provided_context.description: question may have a real-world answer but cannot be answered from supplied state; distinguish “unknown to the model state” from “factually unknowable” and “explicitly contradicted.”

evidence_sufficiency.title: Evidence sufficiency
evidence_sufficiency.description: is there enough evidence to make a requested decision at confidence threshold X? decide what additional evidence would discriminate between remaining alternatives.

fact_vs_inference_classification.title: Fact-vs-inference classification
fact_vs_inference_classification.description: identify statements explicitly present, deductively derivable, probabilistically inferred, merely plausible, or unsupported.

hallucination_detection.title: Hallucination detection
hallucination_detection.description: candidate response introduces person, date, dependency, number, cause, quotation, API, event or feature absent from source; include subtle composite hallucinations formed by combining true fragments.

topic_keyword_fidelity.title: Topic/keyword fidelity
topic_keyword_fidelity.description: do keywords describe the source? overly broad/narrow terms; missing dominant topic; term present only incidentally; rank keywords by representativeness.

information_retrieval_relevance.title: Information-retrieval relevance
information_retrieval_relevance.description: query plus 20–100 passages/items; rank relevance; distinguish exact lexical overlap from semantic relevance; IT/API/code/CSS/HTML/legal/scientific/general domains.

recommendation_reranking_quality.title: Recommendation/reranking quality
recommendation_reranking_quality.description: query, explicit preferences/constraints, candidate products/documents/actions/items; order by fit; hard constraint violation must dominate superficial similarity; ties and insufficient-information cases.

entity_resolution.title: Entity resolution
entity_resolution.description: are “International Business Machines”, “IBM Corp.” and “IBM” same entity in this context? distinguish same-name different entities using address/date/domain/account metadata.

record_deduplication.title: Record deduplication
record_deduplication.description: decide exact duplicate, near duplicate, updated record, related-but-distinct, or ambiguous using noisy text fields.

cross_document_reconciliation.title: Cross-document reconciliation
cross_document_reconciliation.description: invoice vs purchase order vs delivery note; resume vs application form; API docs vs implementation; identify matching, missing, contradictory and outdated facts.

document_consistency.title: Document consistency
document_consistency.description: invoice subtotal/tax/total agreement; stated address vs country code; account owner vs invoice party; dates in plausible order; internal references resolve.

booking_accounting_mapping.title: Booking/accounting mapping
booking_accounting_mapping.description: bank-statement descriptions → rent, payroll, cloud hosting, office equipment, tax, fee, refund, transfer, subscription etc.; debit/credit implications; recurring vs exceptional; business/private/unknown.

accounting_reasonableness.title: Accounting reasonableness
accounting_reasonableness.description: is booking category compatible with description? VAT treatment stated in supplied rules? asset vs expense under supplied threshold? candidate mapping clearly impossible or merely uncertain?

invoice_anomaly_detection.title: Invoice anomaly detection
invoice_anomaly_detection.description: implausible totals, duplicate positions, unusual quantity×price, inconsistent tax, dates, currencies, IBAN/country/address mismatch, changed payment destination.

fraud_scam_likelihood.title: Fraud/scam likelihood
fraud_scam_likelihood.description: emails, invoices, letters, account-change requests, fake support messages; German phone but unrelated foreign banking coordinates, domain typo, impossible chronology, urgency combined with credential/payment request; score individual evidence rather than “odd = fraud.”

transaction_anomaly_detection.title: Transaction anomaly detection
transaction_anomaly_detection.description: usual transaction pattern supplied in state; detect unusual amount, merchant, geography, frequency, timing or counterparty while tolerating legitimate one-off changes.

commercial_price_plausibility.title: Commercial-price plausibility
commercial_price_plausibility.description: given supplied catalogue/reference prices, judge invoice/order positions as plausible, unusually high/low, incompatible unit or quantity, or not comparable.

budget_consistency.title: Budget consistency
budget_consistency.description: proposed spend vs budget categories, recurring costs, commitments and reserve; identify oversubscription, double-counting or nominally cheap option causing downstream cost.

resource_planning.title: Resource planning
resource_planning.description: staff, compute, storage, inventory, time, materials, advertising budget; what is required, optional, excessive or missing; quantities under explicit workload assumptions.

capacity_planning.title: Capacity planning
capacity_planning.description: requests/s, workers, memory, storage growth, production capacity, hotel seats, warehouse space; choose sufficient capacity tier and detect impossible utilization assumptions.

inventory_decisions.title: Inventory decisions
inventory_decisions.description: demand forecasts, lead times, spoilage, safety stock; reorder/hold/clearance decisions; distinguish shortage risk from overstock risk.

scheduling_feasibility.title: Scheduling feasibility
scheduling_feasibility.description: jobs, dependencies, workers, durations, calendars; is schedule possible? earliest feasible slot? conflicting resources? missed prerequisite?

prioritization_under_constraints.title: Prioritization under constraints
prioritization_under_constraints.description: rank tasks using explicit impact, urgency, dependency, cost and deadline; reject “urgent-looking” low-value work when criteria disagree.

pareto_optimal_decision_taking.title: Pareto-optimal decision taking
pareto_optimal_decision_taking.description: multiple objectives such as latency/cost/accuracy/reliability; identify dominated options, Pareto frontier, and goal-compatible choices without pretending one global optimum exists.

expected_utility_decisions.title: Expected-utility decisions
expected_utility_decisions.description: explicit outcomes, probabilities and utility/cost; select or rank choices; include loss aversion traps, tiny-probability/high-cost events and cases where expected value differs from expected utility.

bayesian_evidence_updating.title: Bayesian evidence updating
bayesian_evidence_updating.description: prior plus diagnostic evidence/likelihood information; decide which hypothesis should gain/lose probability, rank posteriors, detect evidence that is actually non-informative.

game_theory_judgements.title: Game-theory judgements
game_theory_judgements.description: dominant strategies, best response, coordination, prisoner’s dilemma, zero/non-zero-sum, repeated interaction, credible threats, signaling; probable outcome under explicitly stated player incentives.

adversarial_agent_reasoning.title: Adversarial-agent reasoning
adversarial_agent_reasoning.description: another actor optimizes against you; identify exploitable deterministic strategy, deceptive signal, incentive incompatibility, commitment problem.

negotiation_judgements.title: Negotiation judgements
negotiation_judgements.description: BATNA, reservation values, mutually beneficial ranges, concessions; distinguish agreement that dominates alternatives from one that only sounds balanced.

probability_support_judgement.title: Probability-support judgement
probability_support_judgement.description: state gives probabilities/confidence/evidence; statement “it will probably be sunny in 3 days” must be evaluated against forecast values and uncertainty; distinguish 51%, 80%, 99% language.

probability_calibration_language.title: Probability calibration language
probability_calibration_language.description: map “possible”, “likely”, “very likely”, “almost certain” to supplied quantitative conventions; identify text whose certainty overstates/understates evidence.

forecast_consistency.title: Forecast consistency
forecast_consistency.description: multiple observations or forecasts through time; candidate prediction incompatible with current trajectory, confidence interval, seasonality or stated assumptions.

counterfactual_plausibility.title: Counterfactual plausibility
counterfactual_plausibility.description: given causal rules/state, judge “if X had not happened, Y would still have happened”; distinguish counterfactual inference from simple temporal reversal.

base_rate_awareness.title: Base-rate awareness
base_rate_awareness.description: rare event with noisy positive evidence; determine whether candidate conclusion ignores supplied prevalence/base rate.

sampling_statistical_interpretation.title: Sampling/statistical interpretation
sampling_statistical_interpretation.description: does a conclusion generalize beyond described sample? selection bias, survivorship, confounding, tiny sample, inappropriate average, percentage-vs-percentage-point confusion.

unit_understanding.title: Unit understanding
unit_understanding.description: compare quantities represented in different units; milliseconds vs seconds, MB vs GiB, km/h vs m/s, °C vs K when differences/absolute values matter, currencies with supplied conversion rates.

dimensional_consistency.title: Dimensional consistency
dimensional_consistency.description: is an equation/result dimensionally possible? energy vs power, rate vs amount, area vs length, throughput vs latency; detect numerically plausible but unit-invalid answers.

order_of_magnitude_reasoning.title: Order-of-magnitude reasoning
order_of_magnitude_reasoning.description: is result roughly 10, 1k, 1M or 1B? detect decimal/exponent/unit conversion mistakes without requiring exact arithmetic.

scale_plausibility.title: Scale plausibility
scale_plausibility.description: is 200 GB plausible for a text file containing 500 records? 2 ms plausible for a transatlantic round trip? grounded in explicitly provided reference ranges where possible.

geometry_and_embodied_navigation.title: Geometry and embodied navigation
geometry_and_embodied_navigation.description: textual 2D/3D spaces, orientation, coordinates, obstacles and goals; walk/drive/fly/jump/crawl constraints; choose feasible action and detect collision/dead end.

spatial_relation_reasoning.title: Spatial-relation reasoning
spatial_relation_reasoning.description: left/right/front/behind/inside/intersecting/north/south; viewpoint transformations; object A left of B and observer rotates 180°; relative vs absolute orientation.

route_feasibility.title: Route feasibility
route_feasibility.description: doors, one-way passages, bridge weight/height constraints, stairs vs wheelchair, vehicle turning radius, fuel/range; decide which route is actually traversable.

embodied_affordances.title: Embodied affordances
embodied_affordances.description: can object be carried, climbed, entered, opened, driven through, used as support given stated dimensions/material/body capabilities?

physical_commonsense.title: Physical commonsense
physical_commonsense.description: stack stability, containment, gravity, support, liquid flow, collision, friction, heating/cooling; plausible next physical state.

mechanical_system_reasoning.title: Mechanical-system reasoning
mechanical_system_reasoning.description: gears, pulleys, valves, pumps, levers, simple electrical/mechanical state descriptions; direction/change propagation and failure-mode classification.

object_permanence_state_tracking.title: Object permanence/state tracking
object_permanence_state_tracking.description: objects moved between locations/containers; after long distractor text identify where an object must, may or cannot be.

temporal_ordering.title: Temporal ordering
temporal_ordering.description: events with explicit/relative dates, durations and dependencies; detect impossible chronology, calculate which events overlap, before/after relations.

calendar_time_zone_understanding.title: Calendar/time-zone understanding
calendar_time_zone_understanding.description: appointments described across zones, daylight-saving offsets supplied or derivable from state, recurring schedules, “next Friday” relative to explicit reference date.

historical_fact_verification.title: Historical-fact verification
historical_fact_verification.description: given date/country plus reference excerpts, decide whether stated ruler, border, institution, technology, currency or event is compatible with that time.

historical_anachronism_detection.title: Historical anachronism detection
historical_anachronism_detection.description: objects, terminology, technologies, countries, institutions or social practices appearing before/after their described era.

geographical_consistency.title: Geographical consistency
geographical_consistency.description: city-country-region relationships, distances/directions from supplied map-like facts, impossible travel sequence, address-country/currency/phone-code consistency.

weather_state_interpretation.title: Weather-state interpretation
weather_state_interpretation.description: forecast table expressed textually; precipitation/cloud/wind/temperature state → supported natural-language judgement; distinguish “sunny”, “dry”, “warm”, “stormy”, “safe for activity X”.

scientific_hypothesis_plausibility.title: Scientific-hypothesis plausibility
scientific_hypothesis_plausibility.description: observations vs hypotheses; which hypotheses are consistent, falsified or underdetermined? distinguish prediction from post-hoc explanation.

experimental_design_judgement.title: Experimental-design judgement
experimental_design_judgement.description: does experiment test stated hypothesis? proper control? variable actually manipulated? confounder? measurement cannot distinguish candidate explanations?

measurement_uncertainty_reasoning.title: Measurement/uncertainty reasoning
measurement_uncertainty_reasoning.description: significant figures, measurement interval, sensor error, uncertainty propagation qualitatively, whether claimed difference exceeds supplied uncertainty.

biological_system_reasoning.title: Biological-system reasoning
biological_system_reasoning.description: text descriptions of cells, organisms, ecosystems, inheritance, physiology; identify plausible mechanisms, impossible category mixtures, cause/effect direction.

biological_signal_understanding.title: Biological signal understanding
biological_signal_understanding.description: symptom/body-state narratives → pain location/type/intensity range, physical vs psychological vs mixed vs insufficient evidence; explicitly reward uncertainty rather than invented sensations.

medical_differential_reasoning_benchmark.title: Medical differential-reasoning benchmarks
medical_differential_reasoning_benchmark.description: symptoms plus candidate ICD descriptions → score compatibility, contradiction and missing evidence; include superficially similar diagnoses, impossible combinations and insufficient-information cases; benchmark reasoning, not patient diagnosis.

medical_chronology_consistency.title: Medical chronology consistency
medical_chronology_consistency.description: symptoms, medication, procedures and measurements over time; decide whether candidate explanation contradicts chronology or known state supplied in example.

translation_correctness.title: Translation correctness
translation_correctness.description: source plus candidate translations; meaning preserved? polarity/tense/quantity/register changed? false friend? dropped clause? added information?

grammar_judgement.title: Grammar judgement
grammar_judgement.description: locate erroneous token/span among \~20 words; agreement, tense, case, article, word order, punctuation; include grammatically valid but stylistically odd distractors.

glossary_adherence.title: Glossary adherence
glossary_adherence.description: given N approved translations/technical terms, detect whether candidate translation uses required terms consistently; rank candidate glossary matches.

synonym_semantic_substitution_scoring.title: Synonym/semantic-substitution scoring
synonym_semantic_substitution_scoring.description: which word/phrase can replace source expression in context without changing denotation, connotation, register or technical meaning?

word_sense_disambiguation.title: Word-sense disambiguation
word_sense_disambiguation.description: “bank”, “port”, “model”, “class”, “cell”, “charge” etc.; determine intended sense from context and rank alternatives.

language_dialect_identification.title: Language/dialect identification
language_dialect_identification.description: short/noisy/code-switched text; language family vs exact language; distinguish German/Dutch, Serbian/Croatian/Bosnian, Russian/Ukrainian etc.; permit uncertain/ambiguous.

code_switch_understanding.title: Code-switch understanding
code_switch_understanding.description: sentence changes languages midstream; assign spans/language, preserve named entities/loan words, understand cross-language coreference.

pragmatic_intent_understanding.title: Pragmatic-intent understanding
pragmatic_intent_understanding.description: “Could you open the window?” literal ability question vs request; indirect refusals, implied requests, soft commitments, rhetorical questions.

sarcasm_and_humor_understanding.title: Sarcasm and humor understanding
sarcasm_and_humor_understanding.description: sarcasm, irony, understatement, absurdity, incongruity, callback, pun, garden-path joke; classify mechanism and whether literal interpretation differs from intended meaning.

humor_explanation_correctness.title: Humor explanation correctness
humor_explanation_correctness.description: given joke plus candidate explanations, rank explanations; reject explanations inventing a pun or cultural reference absent from text.

mood_atmosphere_understanding.title: Mood/atmosphere understanding
mood_atmosphere_understanding.description: cinematic/story descriptions → tense, calm, ominous, melancholic, joyful, uncanny etc.; distinguish environmental mood from character emotion.

tone_register_classification.title: Tone/register classification
tone_register_classification.description: formal, intimate, hostile, deferential, clinical, promotional, passive-aggressive, uncertain; intensity score; detect mismatch with intended audience.

dialogue_coherence.title: Dialogue coherence
dialogue_coherence.description: does response answer previous turn? wrong referent? repeats solved question? abrupt topic switch? ignores correction? assumes information never supplied?

conversation_state_tracking.title: Conversation-state tracking
conversation_state_tracking.description: multi-turn text with changing choices/reservations/configuration; identify latest valid state rather than an obsolete earlier value.

persona_consistency.title: Persona consistency
persona_consistency.description: persona explicitly specifies age, occupation, language, knowledge and experiences; candidate utterance contradicts biography, chronology or knowledge access.

theory_of_mind_false_belief_reasoning.title: Theory-of-mind / false-belief reasoning
theory_of_mind_false_belief_reasoning.description: Alice saw object moved? Bob did not; what does each person believe? nested beliefs, deception, stale information, private communication.

embodied_unknowns.title: Embodied unknowns
embodied_unknowns.description: what can this person/agent know given their location, sensors, messages, education and event exposure? reject omniscient answers.

embodied_time_aware_world_views.title: Embodied time-aware world views
embodied_time_aware_world_views.description: persona, age, birthplace, biography, explicitly supplied beliefs, media exposure and historical time; judge which beliefs/reactions are plausible for that described individual without substituting stereotypes.

embodied_emotions.title: Embodied emotions
embodied_emotions.description: baseline emotional/physical state plus new event → plausible next emotions; tooth pain + exhaustion + bad news vs rested state; allow multiple plausible reactions and reject deterministic overconfidence.

emotion_cause_attribution.title: Emotion-cause attribution
emotion_cause_attribution.description: identify which described event most plausibly caused emotion vs merely co-occurred; distinguish disappointment, fear, embarrassment, anger, grief, relief, surprise.

social_norm_reasoning.title: Social-norm reasoning
social_norm_reasoning.description: given explicit relationship/culture/context rules, classify action as expected, unusual, inappropriate or underdetermined; separate rule violation from personal dislike.

relationship_permission_reasoning.title: Relationship/permission reasoning
relationship_permission_reasoning.description: manager/employee, parent/child, owner/guest, doctor/patient, service roles as explicitly defined: who can authorize/access/change what?

embodied_animal_understanding.title: Embodied animal understanding
embodied_animal_understanding.description: species-specific state of dogs, cats, birds, fish, horses, rodents etc.; probable next action, stress/fear/feeding behavior, threat level, predator/prey relation, health concern vs normal behavior.

animal_affordance_constraint_reasoning.title: Animal affordance/constraint reasoning
animal_affordance_constraint_reasoning.description: can this species climb/swim/fly/squeeze through/open/reach the described object? age/size/injury/environment alter feasible actions.

narrative_next_event_plausibility.title: Narrative next-event plausibility
narrative_next_event_plausibility.description: given story state, rank candidate next events by causal continuity rather than genre cliché; impossible teleportation, forgotten injuries, unresolved physical constraints.

character_goal_consistency.title: Character-goal consistency
character_goal_consistency.description: does proposed action advance the character’s explicitly stated goal? knowingly sacrifices one objective for another? action conflicts with known incentives?

ocr_ngram_based_text_recognition.title: OCR/ngram-based text recognition
ocr_ngram_based_text_recognition.description: full document text plus focused sentence; tokenize into words/numbers and n-grams; identify customer number, invoice number, date, amount, reference, company/person/address from candidate spans.

noisy_ocr_reconstruction.title: Noisy-OCR reconstruction
noisy_ocr_reconstruction.description: `I/1/l`, `O/0`, broken whitespace, hyphenation, duplicated characters; rank candidate reconstruction using surrounding textual constraints.

document_field_association.title: Document-field association
document_field_association.description: multiple dates, IDs, addresses and amounts occur; determine which belongs to invoice, customer, supplier, delivery, payment or order rather than merely extracting nearest value.

document_type_classification.title: Document-type classification
document_type_classification.description: invoice, quote, reminder, order confirmation, cancellation, contract, bank statement, medical report, support ticket, shipping notice, application, receipt.

document_workflow_state.title: Document-workflow state
document_workflow_state.description: quote→order→delivery→invoice→payment→reminder; given documents/events, decide current state and which transitions have/have not happened.

table_reasoning_from_linearized_text.title: Table reasoning from linearized text
table_reasoning_from_linearized_text.description: rows/columns represented textually; lookup, compare, aggregate, identify max/min, join related rows, respect headers/units and missing cells.

spreadsheet_formula_semantics_from_text.title: Spreadsheet-formula semantics from text
spreadsheet_formula_semantics_from_text.description: formula plus cell values/ranges serialized textually; decide result/error/dependency; identify relative-reference mistakes without requiring spreadsheet modality.

form_completeness.title: Form completeness
form_completeness.description: required/conditional fields based on provided rules; missing signature, inconsistent checkbox/value, field supplied in wrong section, conditional field unnecessarily demanded.

contract_clause_consistency.title: Contract/clause consistency
contract_clause_consistency.description: given explicit contract clauses, decide whether proposed action/deadline/payment condition follows, conflicts, is unspecified or requires another clause; no free-form legal advice required.

requirement_traceability.title: Requirement traceability
requirement_traceability.description: requirements → design → implementation → tests; determine which requirement has no implementation/test, which test maps to no requirement, which artifact contradicts another.

business_process_conformance.title: Business-process conformance
business_process_conformance.description: defined workflow plus observed event sequence; legal transition, skipped approval, wrong role, duplicate action, expired prerequisite, valid exception path.

email_thread_state_understanding.title: Email-thread state understanding
email_thread_state_understanding.description: who owes whom a response? latest agreed date/price/action? question already answered? quoted older text vs newest message; attachment mentioned but absent.

action_item_extraction_verification.title: Action-item extraction/verification
action_item_extraction_verification.description: candidate action item actually promised/requested? correct owner/deadline? distinguish suggestion from commitment and condition from action.

product_catalog_matching.title: Product/catalog matching
product_catalog_matching.description: natural-language request vs structured product descriptions serialized as text; rank correct SKU/model while respecting size/version/compatibility constraints.

compatibility_matching.title: Compatibility matching
compatibility_matching.description: charger/device, software/plugin/runtime, replacement part/machine, datatype/API; distinguish physically similar from actually compatible.

taxonomy_category_assignment.title: Taxonomy/category assignment
taxonomy_category_assignment.description: assign products/documents/issues/scientific concepts to hierarchical labels; nearest category vs overly general/overly specific class.

multi_label_topic_classification.title: Multi-label topic classification
multi_label_topic_classification.description: text may genuinely belong to multiple domains; select all supported labels without spraying generic labels; include hierarchical and overlapping domains.

domain_identification.title: Domain identification
domain_identification.description: biology, chemistry, finance, networking, compiler engineering, law, linguistics, medicine, music, statistics etc.; score domain mixture rather than forcing one class.

expertise_level_estimation_of_text.title: Expertise-level estimation of text
expertise_level_estimation_of_text.description: introductory, practitioner, specialist/research-level based on concepts assumed and reasoning depth—not vocabulary complexity alone.

explanation_necessity_judgement.title: Explanation-necessity judgement
explanation_necessity_judgement.description: is answer self-evident from supplied context, or does decision materially benefit from justification? distinguish safety/ambiguity/high-impact decisions from simple lookups.

explanation_quality_judgement.title: Explanation-quality judgement
explanation_quality_judgement.description: given decision and rationale, does rationale actually support decision, merely restate it, introduce unrelated facts, reverse causality or use invalid evidence?

rationale_to_answer_consistency.title: Rationale-to-answer consistency
rationale_to_answer_consistency.description: model selects A but its explanation logically supports B; numeric reasoning disagrees with final label; cited evidence contradicts final answer.

constraint_satisfaction_judgement.title: Constraint-satisfaction judgement
constraint_satisfaction_judgement.description: candidate plan/output must obey many textual constraints: budget, size, dependency, date, allowed technologies, exclusions; identify exactly which constraints are violated.

soft_vs_hard_constraint_discrimination.title: Soft-vs-hard constraint discrimination
soft_vs_hard_constraint_discrimination.description: “must”, “prefer”, “ideally”, “unless”, “at most”, “around”; rank options without treating preferences as requirements or vice versa.

preference_learning_from_explicit_exampl.title: Preference learning from explicit examples
preference_learning_from_explicit_exampl.description: several accepted/rejected choices plus reasons; infer which candidate better matches demonstrated preference while distinguishing stable preference from incidental features.

multi_criteria_scoring_consistency.title: Multi-criteria scoring consistency
multi_criteria_scoring_consistency.description: given explicit scoring rubric, does stated total/category follow component scores? candidate may manipulate weighting, normalize incorrectly or ignore veto criteria.

rubric_based_quality_assessment.title: Rubric-based quality assessment
rubric_based_quality_assessment.description: article, support response, code review, product description, explanation; supplied rubric defines factuality/completeness/style/etc.; score dimensions separately rather than generic “good/bad.”

comparative_judgement_transitivity.title: Comparative judgement transitivity
comparative_judgement_transitivity.description: A preferred to B, B to C under same criterion; detect inconsistent candidate ranking unless supplied context legitimately changes criterion.

pairwise_preference_prediction.title: Pairwise preference prediction
pairwise_preference_prediction.description: two candidate outputs against explicit task/rubric; choose A/B/tie/insufficient evidence; useful primitive for reward/reranker training.

set_coverage_diversity_judgement.title: Set coverage / diversity judgement
set_coverage_diversity_judgement.description: does selected set cover required topics/categories rather than containing five near-duplicates? rank candidate subsets by relevance plus non-redundancy.

redundancy_detection.title: Redundancy detection
redundancy_detection.description: sentences, requirements, tests, retrieved documents, recommendations convey same semantic content despite different wording; exact vs partial redundancy.

information_density_judgement.title: Information-density judgement
information_density_judgement.description: candidate contains useful distinct information vs verbosity/repetition; important for deciding compression/summarization without treating all length as bad.

data_quality_validation.title: Data-quality validation
data_quality_validation.description: impossible ages/dates/ranges, inconsistent identifiers, duplicate IDs, unexpected missingness, categorical values outside domain, conflicting fields.

synthetic_data_plausibility.title: Synthetic-data plausibility
synthetic_data_plausibility.description: does generated record obey supplied distributions, dependencies and business rules? identify impossible combinations and suspicious template repetition.

class_label_leakage_detection.title: Class-label leakage detection
class_label_leakage_detection.description: training example contains target label or deterministic proxy in input; filename/category/template directly reveals gold decision.

dataset_example_quality.title: Dataset-example quality
dataset_example_quality.description: ambiguous gold label, multiple correct answers, unsupported rationale, malformed state, trivial lexical shortcut, answer leaked in prompt, wrong difficulty.

benchmark_contamination_clues.title: Benchmark-contamination clues
benchmark_contamination_clues.description: candidate task reproduces a supplied known example nearly verbatim vs legitimately same concept; n-gram/semantic overlap classifications from provided corpora.

adversarial_example_detection.title: Adversarial-example detection
adversarial_example_detection.description: irrelevant distractors, conflicting metadata, misleading lexical overlap, injected false premise; determine which evidence is actually decision-relevant.

spurious_correlation_resistance.title: Spurious-correlation resistance
spurious_correlation_resistance.description: training-style pattern says one label but causal/semantic evidence says another; names, formatting, length, position or irrelevant demographic-like attributes deliberately correlate with wrong answer.

invariant_detection.title: Invariant detection
invariant_detection.description: given examples/transitions/code/data, decide which property remains invariant; proposed operation preserves or breaks it.

boundary_condition_judgement.title: Boundary-condition judgement
boundary_condition_judgement.description: value exactly at min/max, zero, empty set, one-element collection, overflow threshold, inclusive/exclusive dates; determine which branch/rule applies.

failure_mode_classification.title: Failure-mode classification
failure_mode_classification.description: timeout, validation failure, authorization failure, dependency outage, resource exhaustion, logic bug, malformed input, user cancellation; infer from textual observations.

recoverability_judgement.title: Recoverability judgement
recoverability_judgement.description: retry, rollback, restart, compensate, request user input, permanent failure; classify based on supplied failure semantics.

reversibility_destructiveness.title: Reversibility/destructiveness
reversibility_destructiveness.description: actions/code/commands/business operations: reversible, compensatable, partially reversible, destructive; estimate blast radius from explicitly supplied resources.

operational_urgency.title: Operational urgency
operational_urgency.description: incident evidence → immediate intervention vs observe vs scheduled repair; based on explicit SLA/resource/error-rate thresholds rather than generic alarmism.

change_risk_judgement.title: Change-risk judgement
change_risk_judgement.description: small local refactor vs schema migration vs auth-system rewrite; score probable blast radius using dependency/state/test evidence, independent of code length.

regression_likelihood_judgement.title: Regression-likelihood judgement
regression_likelihood_judgement.description: changed module has many dependents, public contract change, no tests, state migration, or isolated internal refactor; rank patches by regression risk from provided evidence.

human_vs_machine_task_suitability.title: Human-vs-machine task suitability
human_vs_machine_task_suitability.description: given workflow requirements, classify deterministic automation, LLM-compatible judgment, requires external measurement, requires human authority, or hybrid verification.

live_data_requirement.title: Live-data requirement
live_data_requirement.description: can decision be made completely from supplied text/state, or does correctness require current database/network/sensor/time-dependent information?

information_acquisition_value.title: Information-acquisition value
information_acquisition_value.description: when state is insufficient, rank possible next questions/measurements by expected ability to disambiguate hypotheses rather than merely asking for more data.

stopping_decision_sufficiency.title: Stopping/decision sufficiency
stopping_decision_sufficiency.description: enough evidence already exists; gathering more data is unlikely to alter action vs decision should be deferred because critical uncertainty remains.

confidence_vs_evidence_consistency.title: Confidence-vs-evidence consistency
confidence_vs_evidence_consistency.description: answer may be correct but confidence unjustifiably high/low; score whether confidence follows amount/quality/consistency of supplied evidence.

self_consistency_across_outputs.title: Self-consistency across outputs
self_consistency_across_outputs.description: category says “safe”, score says 0.92 dangerous, rationale says destructive; detect contradictions among multiple typed outputs.

granularity_selection.title: Granularity selection
granularity_selection.description: question supports exact value, interval, category, ranking or only unknown; choose the strongest answer type justified by evidence rather than inventing precision.

abstraction_level_matching.title: Abstraction-level matching
abstraction_level_matching.description: question asks architecture-level issue but answer gives syntax detail; asks exact API but response gives generic concept; classify too abstract/appropriate/too specific.

analogy_validity.title: Analogy validity
analogy_validity.description: two systems share relevant structure vs superficial similarity; determine which properties transfer and where analogy breaks.

category_error_detection.title: Category-error detection
category_error_detection.description: treating latency as throughput, probability as confidence, class as instance, map as territory, correlation as cause, implementation as specification, price as value.

cognitive_bias_illogic_detection.title: Cognitive-bias/illogic detection
cognitive_bias_illogic_detection.description: base-rate neglect, sunk cost, conjunction fallacy, framing, survivorship bias, anchoring, denominator neglect, availability bias; identify the reasoning error without assuming every surprising choice is biased.

contradiction_resolution.title: Contradiction-resolution
contradiction_resolution.description: multiple claims disagree; determine whether genuinely contradictory, about different time periods/entities/scopes, or reconcilable through qualifiers.

scope_reasoning.title: Scope reasoning
scope_reasoning.description: “all users” vs “paid users”; “Europe” vs “EU”; “may” vs “will”; “under load” vs universally; detect candidate conclusions that silently broaden scope.

quantifier_reasoning_in_natural_text.title: Quantifier reasoning in natural text
quantifier_reasoning_in_natural_text.description: `all`, `none`, `some`, `at least one`, `exactly one`, `most`, `not every`; identify when paraphrase changes logical force without turning this into purely formal-logic tasks.

negation_polarity_tracking.title: Negation/polarity tracking
negation_polarity_tracking.description: nested negation, “not uncommon”, “fails unless”, “cannot exclude”, “only if”; determine actual proposition and catch polarity-flipped summaries/translations.

reference_coreference_resolution.title: Reference/coreference resolution
reference_coreference_resolution.description: which “it”, “they”, “former”, “latter”, “this version”, “that company” refers to; long technical/business documents with plausible distractors.

comparative_language_reasoning.title: Comparative-language reasoning
comparative_language_reasoning.description: “A is 20% faster than B”, “B takes 20% longer”, “no worse than”, “second highest”; decide candidate ordering and detect non-equivalent paraphrases.

definition_adherence.title: Definition adherence
definition_adherence.description: state explicitly defines a domain-specific term; later decision must use that local definition even if common usage differs.

local_rule_over_world_knowledge_judgemen.title: Local-rule-over-world-knowledge judgement
local_rule_over_world_knowledge_judgemen.description: synthetic world says red tokens are valid only on Tuesdays; model must follow supplied world state rather than pretrained associations.

world_model_consistency.title: World-model consistency
world_model_consistency.description: large textual state establishes entities/properties/rules; candidate event must respect all previous state, not just immediately preceding sentence.

long_context_distractor_resistance.title: Long-context distractor resistance
long_context_distractor_resistance.description: relevant fact appears far from query among semantically similar but irrelevant material; identify correct evidence without positional bias.

needle_set_retrieval.title: Needle-set retrieval
needle_set_retrieval.description: multiple separate facts across long state jointly determine answer; one fact alone suggests wrong answer; useful for testing distributed evidence integration.

cross_domain_synthesis.title: Cross-domain synthesis
cross_domain_synthesis.description: decision requires combining e.g. unit conversion + API constraint + budget, or geography + invoice metadata + chronology; individual subtasks easy, composition determines gold.

minimal_sufficient_explanation_selection.title: Minimal-sufficient-explanation selection
minimal_sufficient_explanation_selection.description: several explanations are true but some include unnecessary unsupported assumptions; select the explanation requiring the fewest additional assumptions while covering evidence.

competing_hypothesis_discrimination.title: Competing-hypothesis discrimination
competing_hypothesis_discrimination.description: multiple plausible explanations; identify observations that favor one, observations shared by all, and what new evidence would separate them.

mechanism_vs_pattern_distinction.title: Mechanism-vs-pattern distinction
mechanism_vs_pattern_distinction.description: data exhibits correlation/pattern, but proposed explanation claims a mechanism not established; score evidential support for mechanism separately from predictive usefulness.

decision_robustness.title: Decision robustness
decision_robustness.description: small plausible changes to uncertain inputs should or should not change chosen action; classify robust vs knife-edge decisions.

sensitivity_analysis.title: Sensitivity analysis
sensitivity_analysis.description: which parameter matters most to decision? e.g. cloud cost dominated by GPU hours rather than storage; ranking should change only when a threshold is crossed.

dominated_information_detection.title: Dominated-information detection
dominated_information_detection.description: new evidence is redundant because stronger evidence already implies it; useful for deciding whether an additional test/query has information value.

consistency_under_paraphrase.title: Consistency under paraphrase
consistency_under_paraphrase.description: same state/query expressed using alternate wording should yield same typed decision; detect lexical-position dependence.

consistency_under_irrelevant_context_ins.title: Consistency under irrelevant-context insertion
consistency_under_irrelevant_context_ins.description: add true but decision-irrelevant facts; answer should remain unchanged.

consistency_under_option_permutation.title: Consistency under option permutation
consistency_under_option_permutation.description: candidate options reordered or relabeled; output should follow semantics rather than positional preference.

calibration_under_ambiguity.title: Calibration under ambiguity
calibration_under_ambiguity.description: clean cases deserve high confidence, near-boundary or conflicting cases lower confidence; intentionally include cases where correct output is tie/null rather than forced class.

format: Each line in requests/<capability>.jsonl is a literal SystemOneRequest. Matching line in responses/<capability>.jsonl is a literal SystemOneResponse. Metadata is separate and line-aligned.
golden_response_policy: Ideal deterministic response: one-hot probabilities for choice/score; noul exactly 0 or 1; confidence=1 for choice/score; usage=0/0; model=gold-reference.
extension_note: Preserves all v3 JSONL request/golden/metadata bytes unchanged and adds 207 suites from the V5 capability specification, 100 cases each.
